name: Project Weeks: Applied Surgineering
description: The project presents current problems in medical technology and teaches the ability to solve complex technical problems independently. During work observation in the operating room, students learn about clinical procedures. In workshops, they are familiarized with the principles of the iterative and human-centered design process in an interdisciplinary environment. In small groups, students develop and evaluate solutions independently and are coached in development strategies by an interdisciplinary team of experts. Extensive material and a practical environment are available for development. Finally, the students present the solutions they have developed, classify them critically and reflect on the development process.
prerequisites:
Basic skills in at least one of the follwing fields is required

- Construction and/or programming of simple robotic systems
- Ergonomic design of work spaces and equipment
- Sensorbased capture methods
- Clinical procedures and processes
